professionalSummary: Associate‑grade Quantitative Analyst with three years of experience in a retail bank’s model validation function, specializing in credit risk model testing, findings drafting, and boundary documentation. Demonstrated ability to perform rigorous validation testing under the bank’s standard, maintain testing templates, and support senior reviewers in report preparation and committee presentations.
experienceHighlights: Performed validation testing on eleven credit risk model validations, including replication, benchmark comparison, and stability testing, with workbooks filed in the validation repository.
Drafted findings sections and open items lists for validation reports, which were subsequently edited and signed by the reviewer of record.
Attended the model risk committee with the reviewer of record for four reviews, contributing to discussions on findings and open items.
Maintained and updated the review boundary section of each report in accordance with the 2024 validation standard update.
Previously served as a graduate analyst in a consultancy’s risk practice, providing foundational analytical skills.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: test workbook and drafted findings section for a credit risk model validation, including validation repository references; the signed report bears the reviewer of record’s signature.
